title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: report.tex equations and physics.cpp implement nondimensional conservative gas dynamics with case-scaled forces.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: global_mesh.cpp reads triangle/quad sections, boundary families and declared abutting zone interfaces; general connectivities unsupported.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp face flux is locally conservative for owned pairs, but partition ghost side is unreconstructed and separately evaluated rank fluxes need not cancel.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: physics.cpp implements Rusanov with low-Mach dissipation and optional HLLC; no independent shock convergence test.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip and no-slip adiabatic wall and boundary-state surface output implemented.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: LSQ/BJ owned-cell reconstruction active; partition ghost side uses cell center, contrary to no first-order-fallback report claim.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: BJ/Venkat and positivity/trust safeguards implemented; production report says BJ. Limiter frozen inside transient inner solve.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Corrected gradients and Newtonian/Fourier flux; ghost-side viscous gradient is zero on rank boundaries; wall traction tangential projection present.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: SGS and CFL control exist; convergence test accepts target/max steps without checking stable forces and steady inner ratio uses update proxy.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2 freezes accepted-state limiter through inner solve and tests that frozen residual; report discloses this, but fully refreshed target misses are unproven.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS, state halo and reductions exist; missing ghost gradients mean separately computed partition fluxes need not cancel. Rank study has 1.3% Re20 Cd span and small absolute lift variation.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
